Hierarchy is key in ensuring normal functioning of our increasingly (398)_______ society. In the US, there is an enormous variety of industries, professional branches, specialisations, as well as a great (399)______ of other domains of  human  activity  or  interests.  So,  competence  here  is  valued and  opinion  influencers  have  an  important  role  to play. In fact, leadership evolves as a necessity almost in any realm of human activity/ thinking, (400)______ where more people are involved. Thus,  it  isn't  hard  (401)____  why  even  in  academic  institutions throughout the US and worldwide, students are given leadership essay assignments. Most students will take on leadership roles with  various  degrees  of  responsibility  and impact in their lives, hence,  becoming  (402)______ with typical challenges, solutions, or skills required is essential.
- Q.398. (a) systematic      (b) easy      (c) fine     (d) complex
Q.399. (a) uniformity   (b) worry     (c) diversity   (d) difficulty
Q.400.

The  country  has  many  non-flowering  plants, (416)_____ as ferns, algae and fungi. India also has approximately 90,000 (417)____ of animals, as well as a rich variety of fish in its fresh and marine waters.

items.text:
Conversation is indeed the (418) _______ teachable of all arts. All you need to do in order to become a good conversationalist is to find a (419) ______ that interests you and your listeners. But the important  thing  is  that  you  must  talk  about  the  other  (420) ______  hobby  rather  than  your  own.  Therein  lies  the  secret  of your  (421)  ______  .  Talk  to  your  friends  about  the  things  that interest them, and you will get a reputation for good fellowship, charming  wit,  and  a  brilliant  mind.  There  is  nothing  that  (422) _______ people so much as your interest in their interest.
Q.418. (a) most occasionally   (b) more likely
- (c) most easily               (d) more easily
Q.419. (a) credit   (b) luxury    (c) result   (d) subject
Q.420. (a) self's   (b) worker's    (c) fellow's   (d) victim's
